title: When the Asset Breaks
premise: Noor Voss, a hostage negotiator whose one failed case left a witness dead and her name quietly buried, has spent six years in a government safe house under a polished lie. When the safe house is listed online with interior photos, she realizes someone inside the program sold her location — and the buyer is the assassin who silenced her last witness. Racing to expose the leak before an international summit convenes, Noor must smuggle the truth past three governments that all want her silent, aided by Elias, the duty-bound handler ordered to bring her in, whom she comes to love. In the end, Noor trades herself as a hostage to force the summit's live broadcast to carry her evidence; the assassin is arrested mid-extraction, the leak is named, and Noor walks free — choosing Elias over the protection program that betrayed her.
about_author: Felix Winterbourne is a former crisis-line counselor who spent a decade listening to people talk their way out of impossible rooms. He writes thrillers about the gap between what institutions promise and what they deliver, from a farmhouse he refuses to photograph.

chapters.title: The Listing
chapters.summary: POV: Noor. Scrolling real estate listings at 3 a.m., Noor finds her own safe house for sale — kitchen, hallway, the bullet-scarred door — photographed by someone who stood inside. Her handler denies knowledge; her go-bag is already packed. The emotional beat is cold recognition: six years of invisibility ended with one click, and the first showing is tomorrow.

chapters.title: Three Flags
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Noor and Elias. Fleeing before the showing, Noor discovers the listing agent's brokerage is a shell owned by a defense contractor tied to all three summit governments. Elias, ordered to retrieve her, instead verifies her evidence of the leak — and hesitates. The beat is wary alliance: two professionals deciding whether trust is a liability or the only exit.

chapters.title: The Extraction
chapters.summary: POV: Elias, then Noor. The assassin corners them at a border crossing; Elias takes a bullet covering Noor's escape while she negotiates their way past a checkpoint using every trick of her trade. Hidden in a freight car, she realizes the leak's source is the man who signed her protection order. The beat is love against duty — Elias chooses her over his orders, bleeding and certain.

chapters.title: Terms of Surrender
chapters.summary: POV: Noor. At the summit, Noor surrenders herself as a hostage to the one condition no government can refuse: a live broadcast for her testimony. She negotiates her own justice on camera, naming the leak as the assassin moves to silence her — and is stopped by delegates watching in real time. The beat is hard-won release: truth spoken, assassin cuffed, and Noor walking out not into hiding, but toward Elias.
